Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 51 S. 2010 21 May 2010 HON. ANNA JHOANNA Y. SARENAS SK Provincial Federation President Province of Compostela Dear Hon. Sarenas: This has reference to your earlier letter addressed to DILG-Region XI Director Quirino M. Libunao seeking clarification anent the proper accepting authority when you, as SK Provincial Federation President, resigns as such. Your letter was thereafter elevated to this level via a Memorandum dated 18 May 2010. In reply thereto, please be informed that when you resign as SK Provincial Federation President, your resignation shall be deemed effective only upon acceptance by the President of the Pambansang Pederasyon. Anent the issue on your re-assumption as Ex-Officio Member in the Sangguniang Bayan, please be informed that we already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 12-A, series of 2000, as reiterated recently in DILG No. 51, series of 2009. In the aforesaid legal opinions, we consistently opined that when an SK Municipal Federation President is elected as President of the SK Provincial Federation, his ex-officio membership in the Sangguniang Bayan is merely assumed by the Vice-President of the SK Municipal Federation pursuant to Section 438 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160). Therefore, when an SK Provincial Federation President resigns as such, he shall automatically re-assume his post as SK Municipal Federation President, and thereby assume as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan. Please find, attached herewith, the photocopies of the aforesaid DILG Opinions for your ready reference. We hope this finally settles your concern. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. JESUS . DO Director III cc: Ls/55•.17 Dir. QUIRINO M. LIBUNAO DILG-Region X1 Davao City

Wilbert Daulat Sangguniang Bayan Member and Temporary Presiding Officer Gentlemen: This has reference to your Resolution No. 46, series of 2009, dated 15 September 2009, entitled "Resolution Seeking an Order/ Directive from the DILG on the enestion Whether or Not Hon. Bryl John Lawrence Villamar Vice President of the Lubang Sli Federation should Step Down as Ex-O/iicio Bayan Member, as llon. Michael Ron 7 'iatson has resio•ned as E.V- Oflicio Aletnber of the Sangguniang- Panlalasvig•an and is Now Reclaiming his Es- Ofiicio Menlbership in the Sangguniang- Bayan Per the aforesaid Resolution and its attachments, Michael Ron Tiatson and Bryl John Lawrence Villamar were elected as President and Vice-President, respectively, of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Municipal Federation in Lubang, Occidental Mindoro. As President of the SK Municipal Federation, Tiatson became an ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Lubang. Thereafter, Tiatson was elected as President of the SK Provincial Federation and accordingly, became an ex- officio member of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. On the other hand, Villamar, as Vice-President of the SK Municipal Federation, served as ex- officio member Of the Sangguniang Bayan of Lubang. On 13 July 2009, Tiatson resigned as President of the SK Provincial Federation and in a letter dated 14 July 2009, he manifested to then Presiding Officer, Vice-Mayor Alfredo Tesalona (now Acting Mayor), his intention to re-assume his post as President of the SK Municipal Federation and accordingly, as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan. In his claim for re-assumption, Tiatson cited DILG Opinion No. 12- A, series of 2000, which deal with the same issue. This notwithstanding, Vice-Mayor Tesalona refused to recognize claiming that DILG Opinion No. 12-A, series of 2000 is merely an opinion and is not binding. According to him, what is binding is a DILG directive or order. Hence, the instant Resolution for our appropriate action. At the outset, please be informed that the aforecited DiLG Opinion No. 12-A, series of 2000, dated 14 March 2000 is still potent and has not been superseded so far. We maintain our view that "xxx when a Municipal

SK Federation President is elected as President of the SK Provincial Federation, he does not divest himself Of his former position because his right to represent the Municipal Federation in the Provinciat Federation is primarily anchored on his being an SK Municipal Federation President (Section 4, Article III, 1997 SK Constitution and By-Latos). It has to be emphasized that when an SK Municipal Federation is elected President of the SK Provincial Federation, his ex-officio membership in the sangguniang bayan is merely assumed by the Vice-President of the SK Municipal Federation pursuant to Section 438 (b) of RA 7160. The said Vice-President does not become the SK Municipal Federation President but shall only 'serve as such'. " For clarity, may we restate Section 438 in its entirety, to wit: "SEC. 438. Membership in the Sanggunian.- (a) A sangguniang kabataan chairman shall, upon certification of his election by the COMELEC and during his tenure of office is elected as pederasyon president, serve as an ex-officio member of the sangguniang pan lalawigan, sangguniang panlungsod, and sangguniang bayan, as the case may be, withoutneed of further appointment. (b) The vice-president of the pederasyon whose president has been elected as president of a higher pederasyon shall serve as ex-officio member of the sanggunian concerned without need of further appointment. (c) The pederasyon president or vice-president, as the case may be, shall be the chairman of the committee on youth and sports development of the sanggunian concerned. Hence, despite Tiatson's election as President of the SK Provincial Federation and his automatic assumption as ex-officio member in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, he remains to be the President of the SK Municipal Federation because his being President of the SK Municipal Federation is the basic requirement for his continued status and membership in the SK Provincial Federation. The subsequent assumption of SK Municipal Federation, Vice President Villamar, as ex-officio member in the Sangguniang Bayan was dictated by the provisions of their Constitution and By Laws and Section 438 (b) as aforequoted, brought about by Mr. Tiatson's election as SK Provincial Federation President. For that matter, such assumption will not make Mr. Villamar the SK Municipal Federation President. He remains to be the Vice President of the Federation whose President was elected as President of a higher federation. Clearly, therefore, while there is no legal argument that Mr. Tiatson resigned as SK Provincial Federation President, such resignation, however, will not affect his being the SK Municipal Federation President as these are two different and distinct positions. As SK Municipal Federation President, however, he remains to be a Member of the SK Provincial Federation but not anymore an officer. Being still the SK Municipal Federation President, he is thus entitled under Section 438 of the Local Government Code to sit as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan. At this point, it bears to stress that the ex-officio attached to the person but is attached to the position. whoever is the holder of the highest position of membership is not Stated differently, the SK Municipal 2

Federation, in this case the President, is automatically the ex-ofiicio member Of the Sangguniang Bayan without need of further appointment per the express provision of Section 438 (a) of the Local Government Code. Coming now to the instant Resolution, it may be true that this Department is not an adjudicatory body, thus, its legal opinion is merely advisory in nature and cannot be a source of authority to invalidate acts of elective officials. However, you are reminded that by virtue of Administrative Order No. 267, dated 18 February 1992, the Secretary of this Department, in behalf of the President, exercises general supervision over local government units and its officials. The power of supervision is defined as "the power of a superior officer to see to it that lower officers perform their functions in accordance with law" (Biro-onon vs. Fernandez, et al., G.R. No. 13981 S, 31 January '2001). Supervising officers merely sees to it that the rules are followed, but he himself does not lay down such rules, nor does he have the discretion to modify or replace them. If the rules n_pt observed. he may order the work done or re-done conform the prescribed rules (supra). (Emphasis Supplied) Accordingly, considering that Mr. Tiatson is still the SK Municipal Federation President, you are mandated by law to recognize his assumption as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan pursuant to Section 438 (a) of the Local Government Code, without need of further appointment. Such assumption is effected by operation of law. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A.
